fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-08-27, several unauthorised transfers totalling Rs. 1,20,000 were noticed in the account of the complainant. The time of the incident was given as 11:10 on 2025-08-19. Contact details given by the complainant, Karthik Pandian, include the number 9000000137. The complainant alleged that Rakesh Gopal may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000405. A further person, Elango Shankar, a business acquaintance, using the number 9000000317, is stated to be associated with the incident. Pandian Balan (9000000285) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The account reference SYN-ACC-100048 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, bank account, morning, associate, mobile number, suspect, witness
